### BorgBackup

**Categories:** Backup, disaster recovery and resilience<br>
**Roles:** Cloud Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure and Systems Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Needs Review

Deduplicating backup program (often used for cluster/VM backups).

**Use when**

- You need efficient, deduplicated backups with encryption for filesystems or VM/node-level data.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You need Kubernetes-native backup of resources and PVs (use Velero/Kasten instead).

[Official site](https://www.borgbackup.org) · [Source repository](https://github.com/borgbackup/borg)

### Corosync

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab, Backup, disaster recovery and resilience<br>
**Roles:** Infrastructure and Systems Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Cluster communication engine providing membership, quorum, and group communication services for high-availability systems.

**Use when**

- You build a Linux high-availability cluster that needs membership, quorum, and messaging for a resource manager such as Pacemaker.

**Consider alternatives when**

- A managed platform already provides workload failover and cluster membership.

[Official site](https://corosync.github.io/corosync/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/corosync/corosync)

### K8up

**Categories:** Backup, disaster recovery and resilience, Kubernetes networking, storage and add-ons<br>
**Roles:** Kubernetes Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Kubernetes backup operator that schedules Restic-based PVC and application-aware backups and restores.

**Use when**

- You want Kubernetes custom resources to schedule PVC and application-aware backups to Restic-compatible storage.

**Consider alternatives when**

- You need cluster-resource backup beyond the documented data workflows or use storage-native snapshots as the recovery system of record.

[Official site](https://k8up.io/) · [Documentation](https://docs.k8up.io/k8up/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/k8up-io/k8up)

### Pacemaker

**Categories:** Virtualization, bare metal and homelab, Backup, disaster recovery and resilience<br>
**Roles:** Infrastructure and Systems Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

High-availability cluster resource manager that detects failures and coordinates service recovery across nodes.

**Consider alternatives when**
